area: Area 1: built-in and contrib text search
current_formulation: fuzzystrmatch offers Daitch-Mokotoff codes that GIN can index, and in 19 the older phonetic functions treat only ASCII letters as letters.

steps.formulation: fuzzystrmatch adds Levenshtein and Metaphone beside the Soundex contrib (commit of 2001-08-07).
steps.quote: here's a patch to implement both levenshtein() and metaphone() in a contrib.

criticism.quote: Note that Soundex is not very useful for non-English names.

steps.formulation: Daitch-Mokotoff Soundex returns an array of codes, one per plausible pronunciation (release 16).
steps.quote: The result may contain one or more codes depending on how many plausible pronunciations there are, so it is represented as an array.

steps.formulation: In 19, soundex, metaphone, and difference treat only ASCII letters as letters.
steps.quote: soundex(), metaphone(), and difference() now treat only ASCII letters as letters.
